# LuaSPortSensor

`LuaSPortSensor` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `sensor:band()`.

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`band()`](band.md) | Get / Set the band. | 1.1.0 |
| [`rx()`](rx.md) | Get / Set the rx index. | 1.1.0 |
| [`physId()`](physId.md) | Get / Set the physId of sensor. | 1.1.0 |
| [`appId()`](appId.md) | Get / Set the appId of sensor. | 1.1.0 |
| [`writeParameter()`](writeParameter.md) | Write a parameter to the S.Port Sensor. | 1.1.0 |
| [`idle()`](idle.md) | Set / unset the S.Port Sensor IDLE mode. | 1.1.0 |
| [`requestParameter()`](requestParameter.md) | Send a parameter request to the S.Port Sensor. | 1.1.0 |
| [`getParameter()`](getParameter.md) | Get a parameter if received from the S.Port Sensor. | 1.1.0 |
| [`pushFrame()`](pushFrame.md) | Push a S.Port frame. | 1.1.0 |
| [`discover()`](discover.md) | Return true if the sensor is alive and updates its module / band / rx / appId / physId. | 1.6.3 |
| [`popFrame()`](popFrame.md) | Pop a S.Port frame. | 1.1.0 |
